events.summary: A fire broke out in the United Arab Emirates on 14 March 2026 during an attack; some oil-loading operations at an oil terminal were reported suspended.
events.effect: Fire with no injuries, confirmed officially; media reports citing informed sources said some oil-loading operations had been suspended (Attaqa, 14 March 2026). The official statement did not say what was affected.
events.threshold_basis: Clause 2: terminal operations suspended: media reports citing informed sources said some oil-loading operations had stopped (Attaqa, 14 March 2026). The suspension is partial and is not from the authority's statement.

review.process: Found by a research lane; then reviewed blind by three independent reviewers, none of whom saw the researcher's rationale or each other: one opened the sources and checked identity, date, region, threshold and every figure; one checked the text for placement finer than first-level region, inventories, dependency and status wording; one checked class, cause, hazard name, episode and duplicates. Published only because all three accepted it; their corrections were reconciled into this text.
